name: VimArena
description: Evaluates AI agents on vim editing tasks in real CLI contexts like git rebase.

binding_vow.description: Agent encounters vim through CLI tools (git rebase, commit, etc). Must edit buffers correctly using vim keystrokes/commands and save/exit. Primary scenario: git interactive rebase. Observation can be structured JSON or raw terminal output.

observation_space.description: Structured: { type, task, buffer, cursor, mode, context, target_hint }. Raw: { type, terminal, task } where terminal is vim screen output.

action_space.description: Vim keystrokes (e.g., 'dd', 'cwsquash<Esc>', ':wq<CR>') or ex commands. Special keys: <Esc>, <CR>, <Tab>, <BS>, <C-x>.

reward.description: 1.0 if task completed correctly (e.g., rebase todo edited properly), partial credit for partial completion

available.name: Git Interactive Rebase
available.description: Edit git rebase todo list to reorder, squash, fixup, or drop commits

available.name: Vim Basics
available.description: Foundational vim operations: delete, insert, navigate, search/replace

available.name: Vim Escape
available.description: Exit vim correctly from various modes - critical for CLI tool usage
